findings.title: RedDrip7/NightEagle_Disclose: QiAnXin exclusive disclosure of the NightEagle APT group
findings.summary_md: Repository created 2025-07-04 by QiAnXin's RedDrip7 team, described as sharing threat intelligence and detection tools for APT NightEagle (APT-Q-95). It carries the report 'Exclusive disclosure of the attack activities of the APT group NightEagle.pdf' in English and Chinese plus apt-q-95_checktool detection executables and checksums. This is the original researcher disclosure that first publicly named NightEagle as APT-Q-95.

findings.title: NightEagle APT Attacking Industrial Systems by Exploiting 0-Days and With Adaptive Malware
findings.summary_md: Early coverage of the QiAnXin disclosure, published July 7, 2025, three days after the RedDrip7 repository appeared. It reports NightEagle (APT-Q-95) attacking China's high-tech, semiconductor, quantum, AI and military sectors since 2023, using unknown Exchange vulnerabilities to steal machineKey material and deploy memory-resident implants, with Go-based Chisel tunneling over port 443, per-target attack domains such as synologyupdates.com and comfyupdate.org, a 9 PM to 6 AM Beijing-time activity window, and nearly a year of email theft from victims.

findings.title: GhostContainer backdoor: malware compromising Exchange servers of high-value organizations in Asia
findings.summary_md: Kaspersky GReAT's first public GhostContainer analysis, posted 17 Jul 2025, fourteen months before the Russia campaign report. It dissects the App_Web_Container_1.dll .NET backdoor (Stub, App_Web_843e75cf5b63, App_Web_8c9b251fb5b3 classes), links its code to ExchangeCmdPy.py and CVE-2020-0688 via the hardcoded /wEPDwUKLTcyODc4 VIEWSTATE marker, notes the validation key is read using code from machinekeyfinder-aspx, and identifies two Asian victims: a key government agency and a high-tech company. The backdoor exposes no C2 infrastructure because the attacker connects inbound to the compromised server.

findings.title: NVD record for CVE-2020-0688 (Microsoft Exchange remote code execution)
findings.summary_md: The NVD record for CVE-2020-0688, the Microsoft Exchange VIEWSTATE deserialization flaw whose exploit ships inside GhostContainer, was published 2020-02-11, six and a half years before the Russia campaign reporting. NVD scores it CVSS 3.1 base 8.8 HIGH with the vector AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H, requiring only low privileges over the network. The February 2020 fix is the patch floor every Exchange server in the NightEagle story must be measured against.
